The Takarazuka Kinen arrives. Biwa<n>Hayahide and I
hold a final meeting in<n>the waiting room before the
race<n>commences.

She's shocked by the thoroughness<n>of all the data
I've prepared, and<n>thanks to my prep work, she's
fully<n>ready to race.

A pre-race poll places her as the top<n>fan favorite. In
the paddock, she<n>vows to put on a performance
worthy<n>of such acclaim.
